fact: The Ministry of Finance's full-year EFY 2017 (Sene-2017) federal budget vs expenditure report is drawn from IFMIS and states that of 174 federal public sites, 118 use IFMIS and 56 use IBEX, reported separately.

The Ministry of Finance's FY2017 fourth-quarter budget-versus-expenditure report, produced from IFMIS/IBEX, shows the enacted 2024/25 budget loaded to IFMIS and full-year outturn to Sene-2017 (July 2025) for the Artificial Intelligence Institution; the document is dated 2024-07-04 but the stated outturn is for the year ending 2025-07-07.

The FY2017 (2024/25) fourth-quarter budget-versus-expenditure report, produced from IFMIS/IBEX for period Sene-2017, gives the Ministry of Innovation and Technology's year-end outturn of ETB 989,820,128 against ETB 2,754,552,330 voted, per the Ministry of Finance data; the enacted budget was loaded to IFMIS.

The FY2017 (2024/25) fourth-quarter budget-versus-expenditure report, produced from IFMIS/IBEX for period Sene-2017, gives the Ethiopian Communications Authority's year-end outturn of ETB 201,551,956 against ETB 203,175,000 voted; the enacted budget was loaded to IFMIS.
